description: Shape of session-state.json, persisted per project so Ask/Agent turns and persona hand-offs never re-derive context that was already gathered.

shape.project_id: string — derived from cwd or explicit --project flag
content_sources: string — e.g. ppt, docx, prd, figma

persona_outputs.<persona_id>: object — structured output block per agents/manifests/<persona_id>.json

full_prompts.<persona_id>: object — { system: string, user: string } exact prompts sent to LLM for training

structured_outputs.<persona_id>: object — { grades: object, score: number, top_fixes: string[] } parsed from persona output

covered_points: object — { persona: string, claim: string, category: string, key: string } deduplicated findings across personas
shape.task_type: string — canonical task type (contrast_fix, ia_redesign, onboarding_flow, etc.)

verify_results.reason: string — why not_run, when applicable (e.g. 'assess_only, no URL')

feedback_log.satisfied: boolean — true if user was happy
feedback_log.comment: string — what was wrong or what they liked
feedback_log.correction: string — how the user corrected or what they wanted instead
feedback_log.original_output: string — snapshot of persona output at feedback time
feedback_log.submitted_at: ISO 8601 | omitted — set when feedback submit succeeds

inferred.<persona_id>: object — { value: string, confidence: number, reason: string, at: string } auto-inferred from next session

confirmed.<persona_id>: object — { value: string, at: string } user-confirmed outcome

shape.vault_path: string — Obsidian vault written by Kavi collect (empty until first collect)
shape.last_collect_at: ISO 8601 timestamp — last successful collect run

host_run.run_id: string — host LLM run directory id
host_run.run_dir: string — absolute path to pending/responses queue

chunk_run.plan: object — chunk plan from the frontier planner
chunk_run.planner_model: object — { provider, model } used for planning
chunk_run.planner_warning: string | null — warning if planner fell back to host model
chunk_run.models_used: array — model names used across chunks
chunk_run.failed_chunks: array — chunks that could not complete

shape.synthesis_markdown: string — Phase 5 composite block for display/export

digest.task_map_summary: string — short summary passed to persona calls instead of the full task_map/persona_outputs history
hierarchy_top3: string — top 3 ranked hierarchy items, if declared
ds_at_risk: string — ds_checklist keys currently at risk
experts: string — persona ids selected for this run

prior_scores.<persona_id>: number | string — last known score for delta re-evaluation

digest.design_spec_status: draft | spec_review | ship | revise — shortcut from design_spec.status

metrics.llm_calls: number — persona calls made in the last run
metrics.input_tokens_est: number — estimated input tokens across the last run
metrics.output_tokens_est: number — estimated output tokens across the last run
metrics.cache_hits: number — retrieve/cache hits during the last run
metrics.cost_usd: number — estimated $ cost of the run from config.pricing (0 when pricing missing)
metrics.deliberation_rounds: number — adversarial rounds executed in last run
